milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the birch trapdoor (placed at spawn-relative [5, 2, 7] on the interior west wall of the oak building) and face toward it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range while building walls provide natural constraint requiring entry, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the trapdoor to confirm visual identification.
